name: gitroot-aware-read-commands
title: Route main-relative git read commands through the resolved gitRoot (wrapper-root fix)
description: On wrapper-root projects (configured gitRoot points at a subdir; metadataRoot is not a git repo), several read-side commands run git from cwd/metadataRoot instead of the resolved gitRoot and fail with Not a git repository. Confirmed reproductions (2026-06-15 re-validation): lattice validate --concept runs git diff main...HEAD and warns Not a git repository (concept reviewer skipped); the finding cluster-sync runs git log main..HEAD and skips with not a git repository; story_discard goes through the same metadataRoot git path (Bug 1a). This is the same root-cause class as B-4e06, which fixed worktree bootstrap to honor the configured gitRoot but never routed these read-side commands through it. Fix: resolve the configured gitRoot (reuse the existing resolveProjectGitRoot in core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts) and run these git invocations there, falling back to metadataRoot for plain repos (byte-identical). Scope to the reported commands; do NOT do a repo-wide git refactor.
